title: Improvement report
intro: What was flagged, what we changed, and what the numbers say now. To add a point, copy an entry below into report/improvements.json (images go in report/).

items.action: Added a straightness check next to PatchCore. It measures how far a long part's centre line strays from a straight line (any rotation or size) and draws heat on the bent section.
items.note: Measured on 12 synthetic bent screws, 12 rusty ones and 12 good ones on a grey background.
items.caption_before: Before: PASS, no heat on the bend
items.caption_after: After: FAIL, heat on the bent section

items.action: Calibrated the score with 5-fold cross-validation, so every photo is scored against a model that never saw it.
Finer features (3 layers), aspect-correct input and a calibrated heat scale. Ordinary texture is left clear, and the outline is drawn only on a FAIL.
items.before: 12% of the heat sat on the defect
items.after: 59% on the defect, about 50x less haze on good photos

items.feedback: The person should train it with their own photos.
items.action: Removed the bundled sample option. Training is only by uploading about 20 good photos.
items.before: Instant demo from the bundled sample folder
